about: The seed cases of MediaServiceCore's VideoInfoReplayTest (youtubeapi/src/test/resources/walk_replay/device_walks.json). Regenerate with: replay_fixtures.py --results <netbench data>/appbench/results --manifest replay_seed.json --out <MediaServiceCore>/youtubeapi/src/test/resources/walk_replay/device_walks.json. Builds: v16 = main a261a486 / MediaServiceCore 9d1a1e65, v17 = main 68620642 / MediaServiceCore 875e29e3 (private videos are no bot check; members-only in Spanish). A case is one simulated device: list several logs to replay them in order on it.

cases.name: kids-signed-out-wifi
cases.note: Made for kids (_WB5hh7WOb4, issue #5), Pixel Wi-Fi, v17: VISIONOS refuses, TV_TIZEN asked without the account serves it at the second request.

cases.note: The same on the Pixel's LTE, v16, plus the next video's preload (another kids video, same two requests).

cases.note: 18+ and not embeddable (qkO6iBwcoe4), Pixel LTE, v16 (no signed-out v17 open of it): WEB_EMBED refuses for its embed policy, the age gate is settled at the second request.

cases.name: private-ordinary-members-one-process
cases.note: One process (appbench --keep-process), Pixel Wi-Fi, v17: a private video (yZIXLfi8CZQ: 'Inicia sesion' twice, the rest say private) walks the lane and trips nothing; an ordinary video right after is asked for (no circuit); members only in the Pixel's Spanish (w664JpkrDio) is settled at the fourth request, then autoplay opens the next video.
cases.priorState: The process restored one bot-wall record saved before this run, which the replay starts without. Its only candidate is the LTE attachment's route record from v16-lte-recovery (TV_TIZEN's media 403 benched the account route for _WB5hh7WOb4 at 09:56:41, 30 min TTL; the LTE wall of 09:59:47 is the record the restore dropped as expired; the forced-client runs in between do not touch the book). The book is keyed by network attachment and this run is on Wi-Fi, and that bench only concerns TV_TIZEN for a video this case never opens.

cases.name: lte-bot-wall-after-a-kids-403
cases.note: The Pixel's LTE run with a one-shot synthetic media 403 (debug.arc.poison_once_itag=any), v16, four processes: an ordinary video recovers from VISIONOS to WEB_EMBED; the kids video's TV_TIZEN media 403 benches the account route for that video (persisted) and the recovery walk finds WEB_EMBED; the ordinary video again; then the kids video in a new process: the restored bench keeps TV_TIZEN out, WEB_EMBED, IOS and ANDROID_REEL answer 'not a bot', the wall is established mid-walk and the circuit trips at the fifth request.

changed.why: the recovery asks a source that refused the video moments ago after everything else (router v20, RecentRefusals): VISIONOS refused the kids video half a second before TV_TIZEN's media 403, so the recovery goes straight to WEB_EMBED instead of re-asking it

cases.name: emu-kids-recovery-after-a-bench
cases.note: v20 on the emulator (Wi-Fi, signed out, synthetic media 403 on the first itag of each open): the kids video's TV_TIZEN 403 benches it; a later process (the book restored) walks VISIONOS then WEB_EMBED, whose media 403 sends a recovery walk.

changed.why: the recovery of a video VISIONOS refused as made for kids asks only TV_TIZEN (benched here) and WEB_EMBED before the sources that never serve kids videos (router v21, recovery-kids): v20 asked ANDROID_VR, IOS, ANDROID_REEL, MWEB, WEB and WEB_SAFARI first, 8.3 s to the first frame

cases.name: private-v16-tripped
cases.note: The private video on v16 (Pixel LTE).
cases.exclude: v16 (MediaServiceCore 9d1a1e65) read the private video's two identical 'Inicia sesion' answers as a localized bot check and tripped the circuit at ANDROID_VR's answer. Changed on purpose: 875e29e3 (v17) confirms that signal only when a second video repeats it, and ef260c6b (after v17) never counts sign-in requests that differ by client. Current code asks the same eight clients and returns VISIONOS's refusal untripped - the v17 open is replayed in private-ordinary-members-one-process.

cases.name: members-only-spanish-v16
cases.note: Members only in the Pixel's Spanish on v16 (Pixel LTE).
cases.exclude: v16 knew only the English members-only wording, so the Spanish refusal admitted TV_TIZEN and walked all nine sources. Changed on purpose: 875e29e3 (v17) added 'Hazte miembro de este canal', which is terminal for the content, so current code asks VISIONOS, WEB_EMBED, ANDROID_VR, IOS and stops - the v17 open is replayed in private-ordinary-members-one-process.

cases.name: walled-visitor-no-embed
cases.note: A real one-minute wall (r11, emulator-5592, visitor 5b2b1c91eb walled since 16:56), v22 installed over v19p with its data: MeJVWBSsPAY (embedding disabled). VISIONOS served and walled at 60 s (playback-media403 signature=wall), the recovery asked WEB_EMBED (refused: embed disabled) and TV_TIZEN anonymously on the same visitor, which served it past the wall; the playback identity re-roll was armed.

cases.name: walled-visitor-no-embed-v19p
cases.note: The same video on the same walled visitor with v19p, an hour earlier: VISIONOS walled, the recovery alternated WEB_EMBED (refused) + ANDROID_VR (walled) and VISIONOS until the reload cap (Unknown source error).
cases.exclude: Changed on purpose (router v22, the one-minute wall): VISIONOS's wall benches it for the recovery and the recovery order asks WEB_EMBED then TV_TIZEN (anonymous) before ANDROID_VR, so the first recovery asks TV_TIZEN, which this v19p log never asked (no device answer to replay). v22's own run of this video on this visitor is the case walled-visitor-no-embed.
